stem.text: The diagram shows the results of an experiment on transpiration using two different leaves. Each leaf was left on a balance in daylight in a closed room and its mass recorded at 1 hour intervals.

stem.alt: Graph of mass of leaf against time/hours from 0 to 6: both leaves lose mass, leaf 1 curve above leaf 2, both levelling off after about 5 hours

items: The loss of mass is mainly due to evaporation of water.
Most stomata close in both leaves after 1 hour.
Leaf 1 has a larger surface area than leaf 2.
Leaf 1 has a thicker cuticle than leaf 2.
